title: Reasoning with Neural Cellular Automata
abstract: arXiv:2609.36126v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern AI architectures used to solve visual reasoning tasks typically rely heavily on global connectivity and synchronization. As biological systems demonstrate, though, sophisticated computation can be performed in a more decentralized fashion. In this work, we test the reasoning capabilities of Neural Cellular Automata (NCAs), networks of recurrent cells that use strictly local connectivity and asynchronous updates. NCAs have been extensively studied in artificial life experiments, but it is unclear whether they can perform complex multi-step reasoning. We show that NCAs produce spatio-temporal dynamics capable of solving challenging visual reasoning tasks, including large mazes, Sudoku, and ARC-AGI-1. Furthermore, we provide evidence that NCAs generalize out-of-distribution when running with larger grids, longer rollouts, or parallel trials; and that the latter can be made more efficient via pruning of redundant trajectories. translated_title: 基于神经细胞自动机的推理
translated_abstract: 现代用于解决视觉推理任务的人工智能架构通常严重依赖全局连接和同步。然而，正如生物系统所展示的那样，复杂的计算可以以更加去中心化的方式进行。在这项工作中，我们测试了神经细胞自动机（NCA）的推理能力，NCA是由严格局部连接和异步更新的循环单元组成的网络。NCA在人工生命实验中已被广泛研究，但它们能否执行复杂的多步推理尚不清楚。我们证明NCA产生的时空动态能够解决具有挑战性的视觉推理任务，包括大型迷宫、数独和ARC-AGI-1。此外，我们提供了证据表明，NCA在更大的网格、更长的演算时间或并行试验下运行时能够实现分布外泛化；并且可以通过剪枝冗余轨迹使并行试验更加高效。
tldr: 该论文证明神经细胞自动机（NCA）这种仅依靠局部连接和异步更新的去中心化网络，能够解决迷宫、数独和ARC-AGI-1等复杂的多步视觉推理任务，并可在更大网格、更长演算时间和并行试验下实现分布外泛化。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that Neural Cellular Automata—decentralized networks using strictly local connectivity and asynchronous updates—can solve complex multi-step visual reasoning tasks such as mazes, Sudoku, and ARC-AGI-1, while generalizing out-of-distribution with larger grids, longer rollouts, and parallel trials.
